title: Early Christian libraries discovered in the 1940s
summary: Diana Pasulka tells of Early Christian libraries discovered in the 1940s, about 1940s at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: in the 1940s we found a lot of libraries of the early Christians and we got an insight into what you know influenced them well the allegory of the cave and Plato's Republic influenced them

plain: Diana Pasulka, a professor who studies religion and UFO beliefs, said on Jesse Michels' podcast in 2024 that in the 1940s libraries of early Christian writings were found. She says they showed what shaped those early Christians, including Plato's allegory of the cave from his book The Republic, the story of prisoners who mistake shadows on a wall for reality. She brings it up as a way to think about how people make sense of strange visitors and hidden realities.
